title: 'The Strait of Hormuz will NEVER lose its importance'
text:
'The Strait of Hormuz will NEVER lose its importance'"

"— Mohammad Reza Naqdi, Iranian Supreme Leader's top IRGC adviser, to RT "

"'If they want to find alternative routes to transport oil and such, it takes many years and incurs very heavy costs'"

"👉 [Don't hesitate to comment if you don't like my translation 🧐 ]
